items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This band was my very first bebop band, and they had like, uh, Illinois Jacquet playing, it was called “Jet Propulsion.”

ctx.x: But, so, that was, this was a totally different, one place and so on. This band was my very first bebop band, and they had like, uh, Illinois Jacquet playing, it was called “Jet Propulsion.” And he solos, you know, and the introduction was piano, da- DAH da-da-da-da-da-da-dan-dan-dan, something like that. Anyway, this was the first time I really felt like I was in a jazz band. It was really exciting and we had “A Night in Tunisia,” “Oo-Pa-Pa-Da,” all these stock arrangements.
